tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find AI API models by name or provider, optionally only those with a verified price at or under a budget. Returns per-1M-token prices with their source and check date, context window and the profile URL. Sorted by blended price (3 input : 1 output) when a budget is given, else by name.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model by short name, id or exact name: price with source and check date, context, open-weights flag, any announced retirement or price change, its recent price changes and comparison pages.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Two to four models side by side: prices (with source and date), context and status, plus the link to the comparison page.

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: Recorded API price rises, cuts and retirements, newest first, each with the date and whether it was a vendor-page or OpenRouter price.

tools.name: retirements
tools.description: Announced model retirements and price changes (Sunset Watch), with suggested replacements and vendor sources. Upcoming by default.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find AI apps (coding assistants, app builders, chat, image, video...) by name, provider or job, with the vendor price note, check date and profile URL.
